claim_verdicts.evidence: RFC 8446 s1 (WebFetch): "the only requirement from the underlying transport is a reliable, in-order data stream". s2: "Application Data MUST NOT be sent prior to sending the Finished message, except as specified in Section 2.3" (0-RTT, resumption only; a first connection is covered).

RFC 8446 s1.2 (WebFetch): "Static RSA and Diffie-Hellman cipher suites have been removed; all public-key based key exchange mechanisms now provide forward secrecy." Each side sends a key_share (s2). Lesson: "a private value it never sends, made for this connection, not the certificate's private key".

Execution: live run inside donhang-lab prints subject/issuer, notBefore/notAfter and "X509v3 Subject Alternative Name: critical / DNS:donhang.local". RFC 8446 s2: CertificateVerify uses "the private key corresponding to the public key in the Certificate message".

claim_verdicts.evidence: RFC 8446 s1.2: "All handshake messages after the ServerHello are now encrypted" (ClientHello is not). Caddy automatic-https: "Normally, TLS handshakes involve sending the ClientHello, including the Server Name Indicator (SNI; the domain being connected to), in plaintext"; ECH must be configured. Caddyfile@stage-0 global block: admin off, auto_https disable_redirects only.

rfc9110.txt s4.3.4: client "MUST verify that the service's identity is an acceptable match"; "requires that a client be configured with a set of trust anchors"; "a user agent MUST either obtain confirmation from the user before proceeding ... or terminate the connection with a bad certificate error". Dates: RFC 8446 s6.2 certificate_expired "has expired or is not currently valid".

RFC 8446 s2 (WebFetch): CertificateVerify "A signature over the entire handshake using the private key corresponding to the public key in the Certificate message". rfc9110.txt s4.3.3: authority rests on "the ability of a server to use the private key corresponding to a certificate". Lab: any client connecting is handed the certificate.

RFC 8446 s2: Finished "A MAC (Message Authentication Code) over the entire handshake. This message provides key confirmation, binds the endpoint's identity to the exchanged keys". Lab -msg (round 1): server Finished precedes client Finished.

RFC 8446 s1.2: "All handshake messages after the ServerHello are now encrypted." rfc9110.txt s4.3.3: TCP connection and port "are outside the secured communication" (round 1 grep). SNI in plaintext per Caddy automatic-https ECH section.

Caddy tls directive: internal "Obtains certificates from an internal certificate authority." Caddyfile@stage-0 l.95-96 "donhang.local:8443 {" / "tls internal". inspect-cert.txt l.3 and live run: "issuer=CN=Caddy Local Authority - ECC Intermediate".

Caddy tls docs: "Caddy will attempt to install the root CA certificate to the system trust store, but this may fail ... when running in a Docker container" and then must be "manually installed". docker-compose.yml@stage-0: web = caddy:2.10.0, own container; caddy-data mounted in web only; no repo script copies the root.
